title: Protected console handlers
responsibility: Creates console handlers that check host policy before releasing stored JSON, media, build identity or downloadable reports.

inputs.name: consoleAccess.options
inputs.type: { policy: ConsolePolicy; data: ConsoleSource; exporter?: ConsoleExporter; host?: ConsoleHost; }
inputs.description: Host policy and data source, with optional report exporter and build identity. Data may be shared or opened from each admitted request; policy must return exactly true to admit it.

outputs.name: consoleAccess
outputs.description: Guard, page entry, JSON, media and report handlers. Denials return 403, absent or invalid resources return 404, legacy addresses may redirect with 308, and media supports byte-range 206 or 416 responses. Policy exceptions deny access; data is opened only after admission.
